name: Hanx Biopharmaceuticals (Wuhan) Co., Ltd.
summary: Hanx Biopharmaceuticals (Wuhan) Co., Ltd. develops immuno-oncology therapies. Its pipeline features HX009, a bifunctional anti-PD-1/SIRPa fusion protein tested in conditions such as lymphoma, melanoma and biliary tract cancer, and HX044, a bifunctional CTLA-4/SIRPa fusion protein.
